newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu, Nissho Iwai buy shares in Qatar LNG firm.
newsitem.headline: Itochu, Nissho Iwai buy shares in Qatar LNG firm.

text.p: Trading houses Itochu Corp and Nissho Iwai Corp signed an official agreement with Qatar and Mobil Corp here on Monday to acquire shares in a Qatari natural gas project, a Nissho Iwai spokesman said.
Itochu and Nissho Iwai have procured four percent and three percent respectively in Ras Laffan Liquefied Natural Gas Co, the second major natural gas project in gas-rich Qatar.
The accord has cut Qatar General Petroleum Corp's shares in the firm from 70 to 66.5 percent and Mobil's to 26.5 percent from 30, the spokesman said.
Nissho Iwai will pay about $30 million for the three percent, and Itochu's four percent is expected to cost $40 million, he said.

The liquefied natural gas (LNG) enterprise is developing gas fields off northern Qatar, and has already struck a term contract with Korean Gas Corp to provide 2.4 million tonnes of LNG a year for 25 years starting in summer 1999.
